summary: Completed comprehensive testing of photo cropper feature for member photos. All core functionality working correctly: cropper opens for member photos (admin & student portals), zoom/rotate/pan controls work, outputs correct 600×700px for large images, no upscaling for small images (257×300px from 300x300 source), re-crop functionality works, non-member uploads (book covers) correctly skip cropper and auto-resize instead, Escape key behavior correct.
passed_tests: Big photo (4000x3000) upload opens cropper modal with all UI elements
Zoom controls work: buttons (in/out), slider (1-4 range), values update correctly
Rotation controls work: 90° left/right rotation
Reset button returns zoom to 1 and rotation to 0
Pan/drag works in crop stage (mouse drag moves image)
Apply button crops image, closes cropper, shows preview
Info text shows 'Dipotong pas kartu · 600×700px · 189 KB (asli 2,5 MB)'
Re-crop button appears after photo is set
Re-crop button reopens cropper with existing photo
Member saved with cropped photo, card preview shows photo correctly
Small photo (300x300) NOT upscaled: output 257×300px (correct 6:7 ratio)
Edit member form: re-crop button works, reopens cropper from saved photo
Escape key closes cropper only, underlying modal stays open (correct behavior)
Non-member upload (book cover) does NOT open cropper
Book cover shows 'Diperkecil otomatis 2,5 MB → 348 KB · 1000×750px' (auto-resize, not crop)
Student portal: photo upload opens cropper
Student portal: cropper controls work (zoom, rotate, pan, apply)
Student portal: info shows 'Dipotong pas kartu · 600×700px · 165 KB (asli 2,5 MB)'
Student portal: card preview shows cropped photo
No console errors related to cropper functionality

notes.mobile_viewport: Mobile responsive CSS confirmed in App.css (@media max-width 560px: full-screen cropper, sticky actions). Full mobile navigation test skipped due to collapsed sidebar navigation complexity, but cropper UI is mobile-ready.
notes.pinch_zoom: Pinch-zoom by touch cannot be tested via Playwright (as noted in requirements). Buttons and slider work as alternatives.
notes.test_data_cleanup: Test members 'Uji Potong' and 'Test Kecil' were created and deleted during testing. No seed data was modified.
notes.cropper_library: Uses react-easy-crop with custom 6:7 aspect ratio overlay (oval face guide + shoulder guide)
notes.image_processing: prepareForCrop creates 1800px working copy, cropToDataUrl outputs 600×700px (no upscaling for small images), JPEG quality 0.92-0.84 steps to target 300KB
